Pizza Hut is on a mission to be the first choice for Australians when it comes to great pizza shared with family and friends. We’re looking for a driven and experienced Store Manager to lead our North Brisbane restaurant and deliver outstanding results across operations, people, and customer experience.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you will take full ownership of the restaurant’s performance, team development, and day-to-day operations.

About the role

As Store Manager, you will:

• Lead, coach, and motivate your team to deliver exceptional customer service and uphold Pizza Hut brand standards

• Manage recruitment, onboarding, and ongoing training of team members

• Drive sales growth through strong execution of promotions and local store marketing initiatives

• Ensure CHAMPS standards are consistently achieved across customer service, hygiene, and product quality

• Maintain compliance with company policies, food safety standards, and audit requirements

• Manage labour and food costs to meet profitability targets

• Monitor and analyse sales performance to identify opportunities for improvement

• Handle employee relations and operational issues in line with company procedures

• Approve and control store expenditure within set guidelines

About you

You will bring:

• Proven leadership experience in a fast-paced hospitality or retail environment

• Strong commercial awareness with the ability to interpret sales and cost data

• A hands-on leadership style with the ability to motivate and develop teams

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

• The ability to stay calm under pressure and manage competing priorities

• A high level of accountability, initiative, and drive

What we offer

• Competitive salary package

• Performance-based incentives

• Ongoing training and development opportunities

• Career progression within a growing franchise network

• Support from an experienced operations team

  Working hours:  Full time or part time 

  Salary offer:  Competitive salary offer + benefits 

  Location:  Lucas 

   

  About the company:   

 Our client is a well-established organisation operating across six locations in Ballarat and the western region of Victoria. In addition to these sites, BCH extends its reach through outreach services and clinics offered throughout the Central Highlands. With a strong focus on health promotion and illness prevention, BCH prioritises proactive, community-centred care in all aspects of its service delivery. 


 Structured as a public company limited by guarantee and registered under the Corporations Act 2001, BCH adheres to a range of legislative requirements, including the Health Records Act 2001, the Australian Privacy Principles, and the Fair Work Act 2009. The organisation is dedicated to providing accessible, affordable, and high-quality health services, and is recognised as an accredited provider. BCH’s services are accredited through Quality Improvement Performance Ltd (QIP) against a range of standards, including the Quality in Care, National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), National Mental Health, and Rainbow Tick (LGBTQIA+ inclusion) Standards. Its Doctors Clinics also meet accreditation standards set by the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (RACGP) through Australian General Practice Accreditation Limited (AGPAL). BCH maintains alignment with other key regulatory frameworks, such as Aged Care Quality, Social Services, and Child Safe Standards, reflecting its comprehensive and inclusive approach to community health and wellbeing. 


   

  About the role:  

   

 Our client is currently seeking dedicated professionals to join our team across various roles and locations. Whether you're a clinician, allied health worker, or support staff, there are opportunities to grow your career and contribute meaningfully. Key responsibilities includes: 

 
	 Conduct health assessments and provide clinical care across various BCH sites and outreach locations 
	 Work collaboratively with clients, families, and health professionals to develop individualised care plans 
	 Support health promotion activities and chronic disease prevention initiatives 
	 Maintain accurate and confidential client records in line with privacy and health legislation 
	 Participate in quality improvement activities and ongoing professional development 
 

   

  What They Offer:  

 
	 A supportive and inclusive workplace culture 
	 Opportunities for professional development and career advancement 
	 Flexibility and work-life balance 
	 The chance to be part of an organisation making real impact in the community

	 Bachelor or higher degree in Speech Pathology.
